name: WiredNYC – All Buildings Data
description:
This dataset contains records for 323 New York City buildings assessed through the WiredNYC broadband connectivity program. Each row represents one building and includes its borough, certification class (such as Platinum, Gold, Silver, Connected, or Not certified), and details about its internet infrastructure. These details cover whether the building has coaxial cable, fiber connections, satellite or fixed wireless service, and the extent of fiber distribution across floors. The data also records the number of carriers and internet service providers serving each building, whether there are multiple points of entry, and the availability of designated telecom space and riser space for current or additional providers. Several fields describe agreements, signed points of entry, and the building's ability to accommodate new service providers.

The data can be used to compare broadband readiness and infrastructure quality across boroughs, identify buildings with limited provider competition or missing fiber and cable connections, and help tenants or businesses evaluate well-connected locations. It can also support policy analysis and investment decisions related to urban telecommunications infrastructure.
